lines.1: 「Let's play nice and sing together this time!」
lines.2: 「Why do I have to sing a duet with you!?」
lines.3: 「Because I want to sing with you, Konoe.」
lines.6: 「...Well, I guess I have no choice!」
lines.7: 「If we pool our strength and score a hundred, we'll get our happy ending.」
lines.11: 「So this is... how compatible Konoe and I are?」
lines.13: 「We've only tried once! We're doing duets until we beat ninety-six!!」
lines.14: Konoe and I kept belting out duet after duet.
lines.15: The young woman bringing our drinks laughed at us.
